description: This file contains a Perl script implementing low-level primitives for AES encryption/decryption optimized for ARM NEON, including functions for key conversion, encryption, decryption, CBC, CTR, and XTS modes, with specific focus on bit-sliced AES for ARMv7 architecture.

methods.name: _bsaes_decrypt8
methods.description: Decryption primitive for 8 blocks of AES using ARM NEON, implementing inverse S-box, inverse MixColumns, and key addition.

methods.name: _bsaes_encrypt8
methods.description: Encryption primitive for 8 blocks of AES using ARM NEON, implementing S-box, MixColumns, and key addition.

methods.name: _bsaes_key_convert
methods.description: Converts AES key into bit-sliced format suitable for NEON-based AES operations.

methods.name: bsaes_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CBC mode encryption using ARM NEON optimized primitives.

methods.name: bsaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks with counter increment, optimized for ARM NEON.

methods.name: bsaes_xts_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES XTS mode encryption, including tweak updates, using ARM NEON primitives.

methods.name: bsaes_xts_decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES XTS mode decryption, including tweak updates, using ARM NEON primitives.
